infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses your location to show nearby drivers, estimate pickup times, and track your trip in real time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NEXRYDE uses your location in the background so drivers can share their position with riders and receive new trip requests while the app is minimised.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses your location in the background so drivers can share their position with riders and receive new trip requests while the app is minimised.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses the camera for driver document verification, profile photos, and biometric withdrawal confirmation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NEXRYDE needs access to your photos to let you upload a profile picture or driver documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: NEXRYDE may save trip receipts or screenshots to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses the microphone so you can book rides hands-free using your voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses speech recognition for voice-based ride booking — Nigerian accents supported.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses Face ID to verify your identity for secure login and biometric withdrawals.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: NEXRYDE reads your contacts so you can quickly book a ride for someone else.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses device motion sensors for the emergency shake-to-alert safety feature.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: NEXRYDE uses limited data to improve the app experience and show relevant offers. You can opt out at any time in Settings.
